label: Amphion Vevo1.5 singing conversion
summary: Optional high-upside speech and singing conversion lane with controllable prosody and timbre, kept as an isolated probe until hardware and licensing are verified.

handoffs.label: Probe a prosody transfer
handoffs.intent: Evaluate whether a permitted reference performance improves musical expression without making the model a core dependency.
inputs: Owned source and permitted reference performance
Exact model snapshot, hardware, and voice-use record
outputs: Short converted candidate and technical/creative evaluation
steps: Run only when the local project path is explicitly installed
Keep successful output as an optional candidate beside simpler lanes
verification: Check source immutability, output integrity, identity consent, and artifacts
Record whether the result improves musical intent rather than merely changing timbre

preserve: Reference consent, source files, model snapshot, and experiment decision
avoid: Unconsented voice cloning, silent model downloads, and hiding hardware or quality limits
